text:
Maya (Product): quick sync — planning Q3 initiative to tighten 99th-pctl latency for hosted API for short sequences (<64 tokens). We need cross-team alignment: eng capacity, runtime kernel/quant work, infra prewarm and pool configs, and security gating for private tenants. Target ship: 2024-10-15. Can each team call out blockers + ETA?

Omar (Eng): putting rough capacity numbers together. currently we can spare ~6 engineer-weeks if we defer one minor sprint. main blocker is a refactor of request routing. ETA: engineering-side PRs + tests by 2024-09-20.

Jade (Runtime): runtime input — we'll need 2 kernel optimizations (short-seq paths) and a KV-cache change to avoid cold misses on small sequences. I can prototype the kernel patch in 2 weeks but need infra for bare-metal GPU testing. :eyes:

Sandeep (Infra): we can enable a dedicated prewarm pool for the pilot. tradeoffs: +predictable latency, -cost. Need exact GPU count. also need node pool IAM for private tenants (HSM/KMS access). ETA for pool setup: 2024-09-10 if we get final numbers.

Maya (Product): rough target GPU counts? can we run a thin pilot for 10 customers first?

Omar (Eng): quick calc: pilot for 10 customers at 99th SLO ~ needs 4 A100-equivalent slots for steady-state, 2 extra for burst/buffering. I'll add numbers into the doc. snippet:```
pilot: steady=4, burst=2, prewarm=2
canary: steady=1 additional region
```

Jade (Runtime): that seems reasonable. to enable the short-path we'll need a fallback variant (quantized model) in case of memory pressure. Can we standardize the fallback policy?

Lex (SRE): suggestion — use a routing policy driven by latency tiering: route to fast slab if tokens<=64 and runtime flag set, else default. Also we should bake a 48h canary with traffic ramp and synthetic SLO checks. I can own the oncall runbook.

Riley (Security): for private tenants we need KMS access pattern documented + audit logging enabled before pilot. also a short privacy review for cache pins. blocker: HSM policy needs approval from compliance. ETA depends on compliance slot (next review 2024-09-02).

Maya (Product): good notes. action items I captured: Omar to update capacity numbers in doc; Jade prototype kernel + fallback plan; Sandeep create prewarm pool request; Lex create canary runbook; Riley drive compliance slot. can folks drop quick PR numbers or calendar invites? :thumbsup:

Omar (Eng): will drop numbers to the doc by EOD today.

Jade (Runtime): proto branch by 2024-08-28. need infra test access — Sandeep can you add me to the GPU pool group?

Sandeep (Infra): yes, will add Jade and Omar. will post node-pool request and cost estimate in the doc by tomorrow.

Lex (SRE): creating canary checklist now. will attach smoke queries and prometheus alerts. quick command to repro latency test: `wrk -t8 -c100 -d60s --latency https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

Riley (Security): scheduling compliance pre-review. dropping checklist link in thread when scheduled.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled: canary-prewarm-pool creation — 2024-09-10 02:00 UTC (automated) :robot_face:

Maya (Product): perfect — I'll follow up with a short sync (15m) next Tuesday to check blockers. thanks everyone.
